Dr. LeB's FIVE Non-negotiable Perimenopause Supps

*All available in my dispensary if you want to try them

1) Creatine
In a 2024 study they found supplementing with Creatine in addition to other lifestyle factors reduced depressive symptoms more quickly than with other factors alone *I like Kleen Athlete Creatine

2) Magnesium
Nevermind that magnesium reduces stress (PMID: 28526383) or balances hormones (PMID: 23056605)! Take Mag to recover from the day and support your circadian rhythm *I like Ortho Molecular Reacted Magnesium

3) Protein
Did you know if you drink a protein shake before your meal you can naturally boost your GLP1? (PMID: 23666746) Or just have a high quality protein supplement on hand because its convenient *I like Ballerina Farm Farmer Protein

4) Omega-3
Getting essential fatty acids like EPA & DHA from an Omega-3 supplement will lower inflammation and improve insulin sensitivity (PMID: 29538286) *I like Nordic Naturals Pro-Omega 2000 

5) Nicotinamide Riboside
So many benefits! But of most importance is the promising evidence we have on aging and longevity due to its natural ability to boost NAD+ (PMID: 37630330) *I like Tru Niagen Pro 500
